CustomField.description: Maximum number of aggregate result rows returned per analytics lens query (LIMIT clause). Protects subscriber org performance on large Routing_Log__c tables. Lower values = faster queries but less granularity. Recommended range: 200–2000. Default: 1000.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Maximum rows per analytics query. Lower = faster, higher = more data. Default: 1000.
CustomField.label: Max Query Rows
